prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Ytterbium (Yb) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a rooftop or terrace above the town of her element's kingdom
Weather / season: a misty morning — soft fog outside.
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Small moment: one stubborn strand of her hair sticks up from sleep.
Outfit: a light cotton slip dress — in black with a single crisp white accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: perched on a ledge or edge.
SUPPORT: she sits on the edge, her weight on her hips.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body facing the camera; camera at her eye level; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
BOTH HANDS: both hands brace on the edge on either side of her hips.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — ytterbium: a soft, ductile, bright silvery metal named for the Swedish village of Ytterby, separated in 1878 in Geneva from erbia, with its younger sister lutetium still hidden inside it until 1907; held one by one in an egg-crate lattice of light, its atoms tick to a steady yellow laser more than five hundred trillion times a second in optical clocks so exact they would not lose a second over the age of the universe and can feel time run faster when lifted a few centimetres, the likely successor to the caesium second; squeezed hard, its electrical resistance rises, so it gauges the pressure of earthquakes and blasts; inside glass fibre it powers the invisible infrared lasers that cut steel — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
